rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 2009).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2009 as 'Happy Ruby Wedding'.
rows.Bloom: Ruby-red. Moderate fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
